body:
Current state, 2026-08-29: storyatlas4s remains a separate sibling with its own Mote store; storymodel4s owns scientific compilation and cross-repo contracts, while this store owns StoryAtlas implementation and local path coordination. No cross-store dependency edges.

Git and landing: StoryAtlas main is exactly d295f4cd67a472d5a0cc295e1c163f5e97805e2b and has no remote. The repaired semantic-selection candidate cand-44Q4P25PQ8KP1ZNR27GNQCMHZJ is exact commit 003f12b21e1b9793fea479e104c2e2eff3e55fe5, tree a6f44747c3f4254c700a7183a2233b9e810e8747, nine declared paths. Formal review approves and exact candidate evidence covers full cross-platform compilation/tests/format/link, live browser interaction, discriminating mutations, ancestry, and Scala type discipline. Chief board post post-01M183JJA3439F69WJWPWKQ0AJ says granted to land, not push, but the formal candidate register still has authorization null and sole blocker authorization_absent. Root requested the authorizer CAS record at post-01M183YK77NXJKB15DCM14NKE0 and msg-01M1840TEDTFXQ2AP8YAZ3ZEZM. Main must not advance until that record exists.

Dependency truth: build.sbt still pins public storymodel4s 3cf704a743d251b0ca09a3238b059e41883370af. Current local storymodel4s main is 1a55f194f88bfa2575a9e915f691d71b938f0e67, eleven commits ahead of origin/main 7385cf9379e59599d1e18370049ac73782844816. Gate StoryAtlas against its declared pin; the later pin bump is a separate bead after a reviewed storymodel4s revision is live-reachable.

Mockup v2: design direction is accepted, with closure requirements routed to bd-01M16MGDPS3Z0ZS9XZT2GFX2AY at post-01M184T109WV95R9HJ0EBHGCJV: portable resolved export, real artifact digest and build/view receipt, corrected Intaglio pattern conclusion, and explicit separation of design specifications from runtime proof. Existing mockups and app/smoke/diagnostics remain untracked and untouched.

Film visualization: the authoritative storymodel4s movie-narrative-architecture topic accepted D10 at post-01M183XFRDCRY9GE168Z6F9PF5. Preserve separate source-observation, narrative-projection, alignment, coordination, and evidence-navigation packets; playback cursor is not epistemic horizon; incompatible axes do not share one x coordinate. A typed SourceOnly diagnostic may follow Stage C contracts and Q5 admission, but no production film workspace or recall voyage is claimed before ADR 0007 Stage E. This is design disposition, not code authorization.

Ready unassigned local work remains recall split-screen, autobiographical-interview workspace, and mockup v2. Chief or the appointed lead assigns implementation; root will not self-claim around that authority.
